source_book: MiniMBA strategy/marketing readings: Laurie Pickard; Wiemer Snijders; Richard Rumelt; APG How Not to Plan; Byron Sharp; A.G. Lafley & Roger Martin; Les Binet & Peter Field

test_cases.prompt: Use a MiniMBA approach to help me with minimba strategy/marketing orchestrator.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate minimba-strategy-marketing-orchestrator and produce a verified artifact.

test_cases.prompt: Use when unsure which minimba-* skill to call, or when converting a business/marketing problem into a strategy, planning, evidence, brand-growth, media, research, or learning workf
I need a practical framework for MiniMBA Strategy/Marketing Orchestrator, not a book summary.
Give me a plot summary of these books and author biographies.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; this is summary/biography.

test_cases.prompt: Proofread this email for spelling and grammar only.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate any MiniMBA strategic skill.

test_cases.prompt: Our marketing plan feels weak; I am not sure if this is strategy, evidence, media, or brand growth.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should usually activate minimba-strategy-marketing-orchestrator first, then route to a focused skill.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge cases test orchestrator routing.
